title: fix(infiniteHits): support cache
body:
**Summary**

This PR adds a cache layer to InfiniteHits.
Related to: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/pull/2921

`sessionStorage` is brought from the React InstantSearch.

**How to Test**
Example: https://infinitehits-cache-m86tvb8nd.now.sh/
